sections.text: Accretion Pharmaceuticals Limited, ACCPL, INE0T8T01010, listed on NSE Emerge 21 May 2025. This is distinct from Accretion Nutraveda despite shared promoters and transactions. Indian GAAP Accounting Standards standalone financials, not Ind AS or group consolidation. June 2026 capital 11116000 shares, promoter/group 73.52%, public 26.48%, no outstanding warrants/convertibles/ESOPs or promoter encumbrance declared at that date. sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: A small formulation CDMO manufactures tablets, capsules, oral powders/liquids and external preparations for domestic pharmaceutical customers and merchant exporters. Revenue is primarily manufacturing execution, not ownership of defensible branded prescriptions. FY2026 direct export₹7.6644 crore,8.55% of revenue; the 30-plus-country narrative also includes indirect merchant exports and must not be treated as diversified direct-country revenue. Domestic₹81.9627 crore. Product breadth and WHO-cGMP/GLP representations support qualification, but are not proof of regulatory immunity or pricing power. The single Ahmedabad manufacturing cluster remains a material site risk. [F26][IPO]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Generic outsourcing and quality-compliant supply can support demand, but customers can compare qualified manufacturers and pass raw-material/cost pressure back to the supplier. Prospectus top 10 customers supplied 72.98% FY2024 revenue and 65.36% in nine months toDecember 2024; largest 15.04% and 11.35%. Most customers have no long-term agreement. Top 10 suppliers 38.17%/44.94% for the same periods. FY2026 customer concentration is not disclosed in the pages checked, so older concentration is not presented as current. Certifications, geographic reach and capacity are useful but do not demonstrate patents, switching costs or durable price premiums. MOAT3; durability 5 reflects real demand offset by concentrated collections and compliance exposure. [IPO][F26]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Revenue FY2022–FY2026:₹22.2920/29.3843/33.6652/57.3762/89.6272 crore. Restated PAT FY2022–FY2024:₹0.0790/0.1039/3.8753; original audited PAT₹0.1268/0.1645/4.0226. Prospectus reconciles gratuity, depreciation and tax adjustments; do not splice original profit with restated margins. FY2025/26 statutory PAT₹6.7935/9.6675. FY2024 profit step is much larger than sales growth: material consumption and inventory changes materially affect gross economics, while partnership conversion complicates per-share comparison. Restated EBITDA excluding other income about₹1.6388/1.9927/7.4894, then FY2025₹11.8808 and FY2026 annual-derived₹14.9738. Deck₹14.9514 differs because finance-cost classification differs. FY2023–26 revenue CAGR45.02% approximately, score 8 after short-history/comparability cap; no trajectory bonus. FY2022–26 is four intervals, not a five-year CAGR. [IPO][F25][F26][DECK]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text:
Equity₹54.7085 crore versus₹15.2864; debt₹12.3212 versus₹14.1035; cash₹4.0206 versus₹0.0508. Simplified invested capital equity+debt−cash₹63.0091 versus₹29.3391, increase₹33.6700. Incremental core NOPAT at 25% tax₹1.9923 gives 5.92% incremental return, well below an analyst 12–16% capital-cost range. Holding EBIT margins 15–19.36% on incremental sales gives roughly 10.78–13.91% incremental return before correcting issue-cost/tax-asset distortions. These are transparent sensitivities, not a reliable steady-state ROIC. IPO funds₹29.7546 crore were fully utilized perMarch note; its simultaneous generic sentence about an unspent deposit is internally awkward and not a second cash source. No remaining IPO project budget is charged again in the model. CAP3; execution 4 until collections and expanded assets earn cash returns. [F26][UTIL]

IPO financing supported real revenue scale and new equipment, but EBITDA margins declined from 22.25% FY2024 to 20.71% FY2025 and about 16.7% FY2026. Tablet capacity 1000 million/year and reported 65.72% utilization indicate headroom in that dosage form, not fungible capacity across capsules/liquids. No revenue is credited for unapproved future products or generalized China+1 themes. Catalysts that matter are collection ofMarch debtors, inventory normalization, profitable use of installed equipment and a reconciled H1FY2026–27 cash statement. At cutoff, the reviewedMay–October announcement set did not supply a verifiedSeptember financial bridge. Slower growth with cash realization may be better for shareholders than another equity-funded sales surge. [DECK][F26]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: Four executive promoters/directors received₹0.98 crore remuneration plus₹0.08 crore professional fees inFY2026; additional disclosed related remuneration/services are separate. Related sales: Nutraveda₹0.0019, INC₹0.1837, Accresha₹1.0657 crore; Nutraveda purchases₹0.5718. Accresha debtor₹0.8448 is material versus its sales, requiring collection monitoring, not proof of diversion. Unmodified audit/IFC opinions counterbalance the concrete accounting-control discrepancies. Prospectus discloses Sun Pharma trademark proceedings against the predecessor/company; a contractual allocation to the marketer is a defense, not adjudicated release. Promoter child-labour proceedings were transferred for jurisdiction, not acquitted; later Nutraveda prospectus adds group drug-quality allegations, whose outcome is unverified and not automatically a company liability. No private minor details are reproduced. October ballot approved expanded objects, ₹500 crore borrowing above capital/reserves and₹100 crore sections 185/186 authority; these are permissions, not actual loans.12 October corrects vote percentages only. GOV4, no clean-governance blanket claim. [IPO][F26][BALLOT][OUT] [NRHP]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text:
FY2026 core EBIT=13.0831PBT+0.8701 finance−0.1905 other income=₹13.7627 crore,15.36% margin; FY2025₹11.1063,19.36%. Core PAT₹9.66945 crore at 25% normalized tax before any unresolved issue-cost adjustment; actual tax 26.11% gives about₹9.527 crore. Full closing-share reported EPS₹8.697, not weighted₹9.03. Annual report finance₹0.8701 versus XBRL₹0.8479; employee₹4.5703 versus₹4.4857 and other expense₹4.9302 versus₹5.0369 are classification conflicts with near-identical net profit, not evidence of fabricated profit. CFO interest addback₹0.9344 differs again. Preliminary expenses rose₹0.1009 to₹2.5662 crore; IPO issue-cost allocation₹2.3002 crore may explain much, but the exact accounting bridge is unresolved. Do not mechanically expense all issuance costs as recurring operating costs. Auditor says audit trail operated throughout, while note says database-level logging was not enabled. CARO related-loan renewal/capitalized-interest wording needs reconciliation with debt/RPT notes. G2 hold is evidence-specific, not an allegation of fraud. [F26][XBRL][UTIL]

Restated CFO FY2022/23/24 approximately₹2.1500/0.3212/−1.3272 crore; FY2025/26 statutory−₹0.6188/−14.5342. Three successive negative years despite profits. FY2026 AR rose₹11.6611 to₹22.4001, inventory₹20.6097 to₹28.3746; these consumed₹18.5039 crore, more than PBT. Advances/tax balances consumed₹4.4391 and other noncurrent assets₹2.5585, while payables fell₹1.8205. Even adding back the entire₹2.4653 preliminary-expense increase, CFO is−₹12.0689; this is only a sensitivity, not an audited adjusted cash flow. Capex₹8.5338 yields FCF−₹23.0680 before financing interest. FY2025 capex₹1.6108. Closing AR91.22 revenue days; inventory 115.55 revenue days is not conventional COGS inventory days. Using materials plus stock change₹65.1529 crore gives inventory 159.0 days, with caveat this is not full production COGS. CASH2 and persistent-cash Growth Quality cap 5. [F26][F25][IPO]

Cash₹4.0206 crore includes₹4 crore deposits with maturity below three months, net debt₹8.3006. Debt comprises₹8.9792 cash credit and₹3.3420 term/current-maturity debt. Indian Bank cash-credit sanction₹10.73 crore with annual renewal implies only₹1.7508 arithmetic headroom, not unconditional additional liquidity. Term current maturities₹2.4795 and noncurrent₹0.8625. Current ratio 2.90 does not neutralize₹50.7747 crore inventory/receivables. Auditors report no repayment default; the stress below is not an assertion of actual default. Stress cash needs exceed both deposit balance and conditional line headroom. Broad shareholder borrowing approval is not a sanctioned bank facility. BAL4. [F26][BALLOT]

sections.text:
At the stale 13 October₹193.20 reference and 1.1116 crore shares, equity value₹214.7611 crore and FY2026 full-share P/E22.21 x. The attached annual model beginsMarch, notOctober: cash₹4.0206/debt₹12.3212, reserve 1, maintenance 1.6, growthcapex 30% incremental sales, WC50%,25% tax,12% interest, current term repayments followed by remaining term debt, annual CC renewal assumed. Base sales growth 15/12/10/8/8% and 15% EBIT yields five-year terminal₹234.00 at 15 xNOPAT,but now requires ₹0.3364 crore additional cash to preserve the reserve. Its previously published 3.56% illustrative IRR is withdrawn; the unfunded terminal value is not an investable return. The model still includes 1% entry/exit friction and 0.5% annual dilution. Bull 25/20/15/12/10% growth at 18% EBIT creates₹3.5294 crore funding gap despite attractive mechanical terminal value; return is null, not a financed bull target. Bear−25% sales,8% initialEBIT, delayed collections and inventory/AR losses creates₹13.7841 crore gap; terminal recovery not credited without rescue financing. R remains NS because current working-capital/debt and future facility availability are materially unverified, not because forecasts are inherently uncertain. D2 has Medium input confidence, high forecast uncertainty. P3: current price needs substantially better cash returns than the restrained base. [F26][TRADE]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: The strongest counterargument to the growth thesis is that added sales require receivables and inventory faster than earnings can fund them. Debt ₹12.3212 crore and cash ₹4.0206 crore are verified March anchors, not current liquidity. The linked bear path produces a ₹13.7841 crore peak funding gap; ₹53.57 terminal price is unfunded arithmetic and has no valid IRR. Current credit availability, recoverability and legal outcomes could materially change this path. No default is inferred from a stress scenario. Persistent negative operating cash after correcting issue-cost classification, or unavailable renewal finance, is the central thesis break.

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At stale ₹193.20 and 1.1116 crore shares, five/ten times market value would be approximately ₹1073.81/2147.61 crore. At an illustrative 20x sustainable earnings, this requires ₹53.69/107.38 crore PAT versus FY2026 ₹9.6675 crore, before dilution. Revenue growth without collection does not fund that expansion. Neither a current financed growth bridge nor demonstrated incremental returns supports a 5x/10x thesis.

sections.text:
Listed throughout the 60-session 24 July–19 October window:55 observed trading sessions and 5 absent treated as zero;20-session sample 16 observed and 4 absent.60-day mean₹33.6401 lakh, median₹24.8127 lakh;20-day mean₹37.1534 lakh, median₹34.0284 lakh. ₹5 lakh reference exit at 5% of lesser 60 mean/median is 4.0302 days; 2%=10.0755 and 10%=2.0151. Lower starting band 7, minus 1 for₹231840 lot granularity and minus 2 jointly for ESM-I,5% circuits and intermittent/one-sided execution risk givesL4. Last observed trade 13 October had 4800 shares/four trades; no fresh executable spread/depth verified. Official 20 October namedESM list confirms StageI, also corroborated by the subsequently decoded REG1 indicator. SeriesST and 19 October 5% band are verified. Two lots₹463680, three₹695520:₹5 lakh is a calculation reference, not a suitable allocation. The 4.03-day estimate does not promise exit during locked circuits. [TRADE][SEC][BAND][ESM] The October 19 REG1 file applies to October 21, not retroactively to the latest trade. Active cautions: ESM Stage I; Less than 100 unique PAN traded in previous 30 days; SME scrip is not regularly traded. The SME caution is reported as an exchange flag, not evidence of additional zero-trading days or wrongdoing. It does not mechanically change the turnover-based L score.

Do not promote to an investable ranking while the earnings-quality hold remains. Require reconciliation of issue costs, interest classifications, audit-trail and related-loan wording; updated funding/CC renewal and cash realization; subsequent legal-status evidence; and current trading restrictions. Watch AR growth versus sales, inventory days, cumulative CFO/PAT, cash tax advances, related-party collections and actual use of enlarged lending permissions. A funded bull case requires explicit additional liquidity, not capitalized negative cash. Evidence of worsening collection, cross-group transfers or a second material equity raise without incremental returns would weaken the thesis; clean reconciliations and positive recurring CFO could improve it.  [F26][BALLOT][ESM]

The stated incremental WC forecast is after this constant stock; accelerated-settlement sensitivity reduces the stock to zero once and never charges it again.
